headline: Trump, Xi Jinping and Putin: Behind the Shenzhen photo there are three agendas
summary: Trump, Xi Jinping and Putin will attend the same event in Shenzhen, with each leader expected to pursue his own geopolitical interests. The gathering is tied to APEC.
why: Relations among the US, China and Russia shape trade, sanctions and energy flows that matter for global markets.
original_headline: Trump, Xi Jinping y Putin: Detrás de la foto de Shenzhen hay tres agendas
